roles.title: Computer Vision Researcher
roles.summary: Detecting and characterizing lunar craters from OHRC images and elevation models, using image processing and deep learning. I designed a two-stage detection and segmentation pipeline on Chandrayaan-2 terrain models that reaches 0.83 mIoU on crater tiles.

roles.title: Software Engineering Intern
roles.summary: Applied machine learning for the agricultural commodity markets of Gujarat. I built XGBoost price-forecasting models for non-perishable commodities that beat a seasonal-naive baseline by 40% on held-out seasons, and procurement-timing signals from price z-scores and crop-arrival data across 20 collection centers. I also shipped a daily pipeline over 200+ commodity-market pairs and backtested weather-driven supply-shock indicators on five seasons, to flag procurement risk early.
